name: providers
description: Rate metadata (asOf, availableAt, validUntil, type, quote, derivedFrom) through inverses, chains, margins and rounding; availability and expiry of dates and instants at UTC day boundaries; the JSON form; strict validity; rate tables, chain, reversed, via and identity; converting through a provider; and multi-currency bags totalled and sorted through one.

provenance.method: Rates, their metadata and providers modelled from docs/reference/convert.md with Python's fractions and datetime, times as instants and whole UTC days rather than strings, independently of ducat's TypeScript.
